n_states_computed.description: Singlet excited states computed per functional (CAM-B3LYP, full RPA)

n_states_under_band.description: States within +/-0.35 eV of the lowest bright transition (CAM-B3LYP)

n_bright_under_band.description: Bright states within +/-0.35 eV of the lowest bright transition (CAM-B3LYP)

f_fraction_outside_band.description: Fraction of total oscillator strength lying outside the apparent absorption band (CAM-B3LYP)

f_fraction_in_lowest_bright.description: Fraction of total oscillator strength carried by the lowest bright state alone (CAM-B3LYP)

s1_s2_gap_ev.description: Energy gap from S1 to S2 (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP), independent of any band-width convention

s1_s3_gap_ev.description: Energy gap from S1 to S3 (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP), independent of any band-width convention

lowest_two_bright_gap_ev.description: Energy gap between the two lowest states with f >= 0.01 (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP)

band_center_nm.description: Vertical excitation wavelength of the lowest bright state (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP)

band_center_ev.description: Vertical excitation energy of the lowest bright state (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP)

band_center_nm_b3lyp.description: Lowest bright state wavelength under B3LYP, as a functional sensitivity check

lowest_bright_f.description: Oscillator strength of the lowest bright state (CAM-B3LYP)

uff_interring_twist_deg.description: Twist between the dimethylaniline and dihydrofuran ring planes in the UFF starting structure

opt_interring_twist_deg.description: Twist between the dimethylaniline and dihydrofuran ring planes at the B3LYP/def2-SVP minimum

interring_twist_change_deg.description: Change in inter-ring twist from the UFF starting structure to the B3LYP/def2-SVP minimum

benzene_cc_bond_spread_ang.description: Spread between longest and shortest C-C bond at benzene's B3LYP/def2-SVP minimum

s1_s2_gap_ev_b3lyp.description: Energy gap from S1 to S2 under B3LYP/def2-TZVP, showing the isolated lowest state is not an artefact of functional choice

functional_shift_ev.description: Blue shift of the lowest bright state from B3LYP to CAM-B3LYP, the signature of charge-transfer character

stationary_twist20_rise_kcal.description: Energy rise on rigidly twisting the donor ring 20 degrees from the planar minimum

stationary_twist10_rise_kcal.description: Energy rise on rigidly twisting the donor ring 10 degrees from the planar minimum

stationary_pyramid_rise_kcal.description: Energy rise on displacing the amine nitrogen 0.15 A out of its substituent plane

stationary_worst_pair_split_uhartree.description: Largest energy split between mirror-related displacement pairs, the self-test on the displacement construction

benzene_n_states_under_band.description: States within +/-0.35 eV of benzene's lowest bright transition (CAM-B3LYP)

benzene_n_bright_under_band.description: Bright states within the same window of benzene's lowest bright transition (CAM-B3LYP)

benzene_band_center_ev.description: Vertical excitation energy of benzene's lowest bright state (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP)

benzene_lowest_two_bright_gap_ev.description: Splitting between benzene's two lowest bright states, degenerate under D6h symmetry

benzene_lowest_bright_f_share.description: Share of the two lowest bright states' combined oscillator strength carried by the lower one (benzene; 50% = an even split)

lowest_bright_f_share.description: Share of the two lowest bright states' combined oscillator strength carried by the lower one (DCDHF-Me2, CAM-B3LYP)

broadening_fwhm_ev_cosmetic.description: Gaussian FWHM applied by hand for display only; not a computed line shape
